details:
Please add Serbian (Српски) and Bosnian (Bosanski) to the list of selectable spoken languages in VRChat user profiles.

This request is not about translating the VRChat interface. It is specifically about the Spoken Languages / Languages section of user profiles, where players can select the languages they speak so other users can see them.

Currently, neither Serbian nor Bosnian is available, which means millions of speakers cannot accurately represent their native language on their profile.

This is especially confusing when other languages from the region are available. Adding Serbian and Bosnian would make the language selection more complete and useful for players from the Balkans.

Why add them?

Serbian-speaking players could accurately identify their language.

Bosnian-speaking players could accurately identify their language.

It would make it easier for users to find others who speak the same language.

It would make the spoken-language list more inclusive and representative.

These are relatively simple additions to the existing profile language system.

If VRChat prefers to reduce the number of individual entries, a Serbo-Croatian option could also be considered as an alternative for Serbian, Croatian, Bosnian, and Montenegrin speakers. However, having Serbian and Bosnian as separate selectable languages would be the preferred solution.

This is not a request for political recognition or for changing the language of VRChat. It is simply a request to allow users to accurately state which language they speak on their profile.

Please consider adding Serbian and Bosnian to the profile spoken-language list.

Upvote this request if you would also like to see Serbian and Bosnian available as profile languages.
title: Add Serbian and Bosnian to Profile Spoken Languages
